workflows.content:
name: CI
on: [pull_request, push]
permissions: {}
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1 # locked in actions.lock
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@4be9e76fd7c4901c3a2a0e2f3e8f9b2f8a1f4e55 # v1.0.0
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup
      # - uses: actions/cache@v4   (commented out, must not count)
      - if: github.event_name == 'workflow_run'
        run: echo "an expression in a job is not a trigger"
      - run: cargo test

name: Lockfile
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions: {}
jobs:
  lockfile:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - run: gh extension install github/gh-actions-lock --pin 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567  # v0.4.1
      - run: gh actions-lock --verify

name: zizmor
on: [pull_request]  # never pull_request_target
permissions: {}
jobs:
  zizmor:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - run: uvx --from zizmor==1.32.0 zizmor --persona regular --min-severity high --min-confidence high --format github .github/workflows

lockfile:
# Do not edit by hand; run `gh actions-lock` to update.
version: v0.0.3
dependabot:
version: 2
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: cargo
    directory: /
    schedule:
      interval: daily
    open-pull-requests-limit: 5
  - package-ecosystem: github-actions
    directory: /
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
    open-pull-requests-limit: 1
    cooldown:
      default-days: 7
    groups:
      github-actions:
        patterns:
          - "*"
